hero.headline: Modernize Your Restaurant, Maximize Your Efficiency
hero.subheadline: Streamline your entire operation – from front-of-house to back-of-house – increase table turnover, and reduce costly errors. Scerv is the all-in-one platform built for restaurant success.
hero.intro: Scerv empowers you to take control of your restaurant, optimize your workflow, and deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while boosting your bottom line.

ordering.title: Integrated Digital Ordering
ordering.desc: Scerv revolutionizes the dining experience with a seamless, integrated digital ordering system. Customers order directly through the mobile app, eliminating the need for traditional terminal wait times. Checkouts are managed automatically in the background, streamlining operations and enhancing customer satisfaction.

queue.title: Chef's Q™
queue.desc: Streamline your kitchen operations with Scerv's Chef's Q. Incoming orders are automatically grouped by table and displayed clearly on a dedicated kitchen display system (KDS). This eliminates the need for paper tickets, reduces errors, and improves communication between front-of-house and back-of-house staff. Special instructions are clearly displayed, ensuring order accuracy and customer satisfaction. Optimize order preparation and delivery for maximum efficiency.

analytics.title: Real-Time Analytics & Reporting
analytics.desc: Gain valuable insights into your restaurant's performance with Scerv's comprehensive reporting tools. Track sales, identify popular items, monitor customer behavior, and make data-driven decisions to optimize your menu, pricing, and staffing.

solutions.title: Built for Every Part of Your Restaurant
solutions.subtitle: Scerv scales with your operations, increasing revenue while removing friction from the dining experience.

foh.headline: Turn Tables 20% Faster
foh.desc: Empower your servers to focus on hospitality, not managing checkouts. With Scerv's unified app experience, guests seat themselves, order instantly, and manage their individual tabs seamlessly without waiting on staff.

boh.headline: Smart Routing & Chef's Q™
boh.desc: Eliminate lost paper tickets and kitchen bottlenecks. Scerv automatically routes drink orders to the bar and food orders to the kitchen display system (KDS). Everything is timed perfectly for maximum efficiency.

guests.headline: Break the Language Barrier
guests.desc: Capture more tourist revenue with auto-translating menus. Guests browse and order in English on their phones, while your kitchen receives the exact same ticket translated instantly into Spanish. Zero confusion.

footer.tagline: The all-in-one restaurant management platform built for efficiency and growth.

about.heroSubtitle: We built Scerv to eliminate friction in the hospitality industry, empowering local restaurants with world-class "Smart City" infrastructure.
about.missionP1: Whether you are a local resident or a tourist exploring a new city, the dining experience should be about the food and the company—not waiting 15 minutes to flag down a server to manage the check or struggling with a language barrier.
about.missionP2: Scerv puts the power back in the hands of the customer and the restaurant owner. By introducing a seamless digital checkout experience, we help restaurants turn tables faster, operate leaner, and provide an unforgettable, frictionless VIP experience to every guest.
about.whyPanamaP: As a rising global hub for digital nomads, expats, and culinary tourism, Panama City is the perfect launchpad. We are committed to helping local Panamanian businesses compete on a global stage by providing them with the exact same enterprise-level tools used in cities like New York and Dubai.
